description.narrative: Electric Networks of Armenia (ENA) is undertaking a second phase of the 2016-2027 investment program. Under the second phase, the project will cover 2021-2022 investment needs and is aimed at (i) substation modernization and reinforcement; (ii) network expansion and improvement; (iii) automatic metering systems installation; and (iv) other investments.
